variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a newly designed rhythm-game SINGLE LONG-NOTE BODY texture tile. The provided image is the ONLY visual reference: it is a Classic point note. Borrow its cool sapphire/cobalt blue, glossy blue glass, navy recesses and icy silver metal material family. Invent a NEW body; do not reproduce the point note or add a head/cap. Orthographic front-facing 2D game sprite with tasteful dimensional bevels, crisp and readable at 100px width. Requested tile aspect ratio is exactly 100:20 (5:1). Fill the entire canvas edge to edge with the rectangular material; no margins, perspective, mockup, presentation board, text or labels. It must seamlessly repeat UP AND DOWN, with matching top/bottom cross-sections and continuous side rails: no horizontal outer border, no top or bottom bevel/end cap, no edge shading that creates a horizontal seam. This is a single repeat tile, not an assembled long note. Do not add any other assets. Keep the point note's coherent polished game-art style, avoid photographic noise or grit. Distinct design direction: One broad uninterrupted sapphire-glass ribbon. Almost the entire width is a single generous curved blue glass surface with luminous icy edges and a restrained cool central reflection. Very narrow silver outer bevels. Calm, bold, solid silhouette. No internal stripes or lattice; make this a continuous broad material surface.
